meta.title: Defer class resolution in parser
meta.body_summary: Defer class resolution in the JSON parser by storing unresolved type names in JsonValue instead of loading classes eagerly, and resolve them later in the Resolver, with a unit test verifying the deferred type behavior.

core_change_summary.description: Modified JsonParser to store unresolved type names in JsonValue instead of loading classes eagerly. Added type resolution deferred to Resolver class, and updated MapResolver/ObjectResolver to handle pending types. Added unit test.
